definitions: A rural area located in the Cherkasy Oblast of Ukraine, known for its agricultural landscapes and traditional Ukrainian culture.
Refers to the non-urbanized parts of the Cherkasy region in central Ukraine, characterized by villages, farms, and natural environments.
examples: Many tourists visit Rural Cherkaschyna for its scenic beauty.
The economy of Rural Cherkaschyna is largely based on agriculture.
Traditional crafts are still practiced in Rural Cherkaschyna.
